# Demo script

- Choose one implemented capability and one licensed or synthetic audio sample.
- Show input command or API call and resulting output.
- State language model and hardware assumptions when relevant.
- Include one visible limitation or failure mode when practical.
- Do not imply speaker identity accuracy or consent beyond the demonstrated fixture.
- Make every command reproducible from a clean checkout.
